entries.name: repeat
entries.about: Run the instructions n times. REPCOUNT gives the current count.

entries.name: forever
entries.about: Run the instructions until an error, STOP or Ctrl-C.

entries.name: repcount
entries.about: The number of the current REPEAT/FOREVER/FOREACH pass, starting at 1.

entries.name: if
entries.about: Run the list if test is true. (if test [then] [else]) also works in parentheses.

entries.name: ifelse
entries.about: Run one list or the other. Outputs the list's value if it has one.

entries.name: test
entries.about: Remember a condition for IFTRUE and IFFALSE.

entries.name: iftrue
entries.about: Run the list if the last TEST was true. Alias: IFT.

entries.name: iffalse
entries.about: Run the list if the last TEST was false. Alias: IFF.

entries.name: while
entries.about: Repeat while the condition list outputs true.

entries.name: until
entries.about: Repeat until the condition list outputs true.

entries.name: do.while
entries.about: Run once, then repeat while the condition is true.

entries.name: do.until
entries.about: Run once, then repeat until the condition is true.

entries.name: for
entries.about: Count var from start to limit. Step is optional.

entries.name: stop
entries.about: Leave the current procedure.

entries.name: output
entries.about: Leave the current procedure, returning value. Alias: OP.

entries.name: bye
entries.about: Leave Logo.

entries.name: run
entries.about: Run a list as code. Outputs the last value if it makes one.

entries.name: runresult
entries.about: Like RUN, but outputs a list holding the value, or [] if none.

entries.name: wait
entries.about: Pause for n sixtieths of a second (and redraw the canvas).

entries.name: catch
entries.about: Run the list; THROW "tag jumps back here. CATCH "ERROR traps errors.

entries.name: throw
entries.about: Jump to the matching CATCH. (throw "tag value) passes a value.

entries.name: goto
entries.about: Jump to TAG "tag in the same procedure. Works from inside IF, REPEAT and other lists.

entries.name: tag
entries.about: Mark a place for GOTO. Does nothing when run.

entries.name: .maybeoutput
entries.about: Output the value if the input made one; if it made none, behave like STOP.

entries.name: error
entries.about: After CATCH "ERROR caught something, outputs [code message procedure line].

entries.name: make
entries.about: Set a variable. Names are case-insensitive and scope is dynamic.

entries.name: name
entries.about: Like MAKE with the inputs the other way round.

entries.name: thing
entries.about: The value of a variable. :name is shorthand.

entries.name: local
entries.about: Make a variable local to the current procedure. (local "a "b) takes several.

entries.name: localmake
entries.about: Make and set a local variable.

entries.name: global
entries.about: Declare a global variable.

entries.name: namep
entries.about: True if the variable exists. Alias: NAME?

entries.name: procedurep
entries.about: True if a procedure of that name is defined. Aliases: PROCEDURE?, DEFINEDP.

entries.name: primitivep
entries.about: True if the name is a built-in command. Alias: PRIMITIVE?

entries.name: erase
entries.about: Delete a procedure. Alias: ER.

entries.name: erall
entries.about: Delete every procedure and variable.

entries.name: define
entries.about: Build a procedure from a list.

entries.name: text
entries.about: A procedure's definition as a list, suitable for DEFINE.

entries.name: pots
entries.about: Print the title line of every procedure.

entries.name: pons
entries.about: Print every global variable as a MAKE line.

entries.name: po
entries.about: Print a procedure's full definition.

entries.name: load
entries.about: Run a Logo source file, adding its procedures.

entries.name: save
entries.about: Write all procedures and variables to a file that LOAD can read back.

entries.name: foreach
entries.about: Run the template once per item, with ? as the item.

entries.name: map
entries.about: A list of the template's value for each item. Eg: map [? * 2] [1 2 3]

entries.name: filter
entries.about: The items for which the template is true.

entries.name: find
entries.about: The first item for which the template is true, else [].

entries.name: reduce
entries.about: Combine items with a two-input template (?1, ?2). Eg: reduce [?1 + ?2] [1 2 3]

entries.name: apply
entries.about: Call a template or procedure name with a list of inputs.

entries.name: invoke
entries.about: Call a template with the inputs given (use parentheses for several).

entries.name: print
entries.about: Print a word or list without its outer brackets. Alias: PR.

entries.name: type
entries.about: Print without a newline.

entries.name: show
entries.about: Print a list with its brackets.

entries.name: readword
entries.about: Read a line of typed input as one word. Alias: RW.

entries.name: readlist
entries.about: Read a line of typed input as a list. Alias: RL.

entries.name: cleartext
entries.about: Clear the text area. Alias: CT.

entries.name: readchar
entries.about: Wait for one key and output it (Enter gives a newline), or [] at the end of input. From a file when SETREAD is in use. Escape stops. Alias: RC.

entries.name: readchars
entries.about: Output the next n characters, or [] at the end of input. Alias: RCS.

entries.name: keyp
entries.about: True if a key has been pressed and READCHAR has not yet taken it (or the file has more to read). Alias: KEY?.

entries.name: cursor
entries.about: Output [column row] of the text cursor in the text area under the canvas. Counts from 0.

entries.name: setcursor
entries.about: Move the text cursor within the text area (80 columns by 5 rows at most); TYPE and PRINT then overwrite what is there. Lasts for one command in the REPL. Does nothing outside the REPL.

entries.name: openread
entries.about: Open a file for reading. SETREAD then makes READWORD, READLIST, READCHAR and EOFP use it.

entries.name: openwrite
entries.about: Create or empty a file for writing. SETWRITE then makes PRINT, TYPE and SHOW write to it.

entries.name: openappend
entries.about: Open a file for writing at its end.

entries.name: openupdate
entries.about: Open an existing file (or a new one) for reading and writing from the start.

entries.name: close
entries.about: Close a file opened with one of the OPEN commands.

entries.name: closeall
entries.about: Close every open file.

entries.name: allopen
entries.about: Output the list of open files.

entries.name: setread
entries.about: Read from this open file. SETREAD [] goes back to the keyboard.

entries.name: setwrite
entries.about: Write PRINT, TYPE and SHOW output to this open file. SETWRITE [] goes back to the screen.

entries.name: reader
entries.about: Output the file being read, or [] for the keyboard.

entries.name: writer
entries.about: Output the file being written, or [] for the screen.

entries.name: readpos
entries.about: Output the current position in the read file.

entries.name: setreadpos
entries.about: Move to position n in the read file.

entries.name: writepos
entries.about: Output the current position in the write file.

entries.name: setwritepos
entries.about: Move to position n in the write file.

entries.name: eofp
entries.about: True if the read file has nothing more to read. Alias: EOF?.

entries.name: filep
entries.about: True if the file exists. Alias: FILE?.

entries.name: erasefile
entries.about: Delete a file. Alias: ERF.

entries.name: word
entries.about: Join words. (word a b c) takes more.

entries.name: list
entries.about: Make a list of the inputs. (list a b c) takes more.

entries.name: sentence
entries.about: Join inputs into one flat list. Alias: SE.

entries.name: fput
entries.about: Put an item at the front of a list.

entries.name: lput
entries.about: Put an item at the end of a list.

entries.name: combine
entries.about: FPUT if b is a list, otherwise WORD.

entries.name: reverse
entries.about: Reverse a list or word.

entries.name: remove
entries.about: The list without any copies of item.

entries.name: remdup
entries.about: The list with duplicates removed.

entries.name: iseq
entries.about: The integers from..to as a list. Counts down if from > to.

entries.name: rseq
entries.about: count evenly spaced numbers from..to.

entries.name: first
entries.about: First item of a list, or first letter of a word.

entries.name: last
entries.about: Last item or letter.

entries.name: butfirst
entries.about: All but the first item or letter. Alias: BF.

entries.name: butlast
entries.about: All but the last item or letter. Alias: BL.

entries.name: item
entries.about: The nth item or letter (counting from 1).

entries.name: pick
entries.about: A random item.

entries.name: count
entries.about: How many items or letters.

entries.name: member
entries.about: The list from the first match onwards, else [].

entries.name: memberp
entries.about: True if the item is in the list. Alias: MEMBER?

entries.name: emptyp
entries.about: True for [] or the empty word. Alias: EMPTY?

entries.name: listp
entries.about: True if a list. Alias: LIST?

entries.name: wordp
entries.about: True if a word. Alias: WORD?

entries.name: numberp
entries.about: True if a number. Alias: NUMBER?

entries.name: equalp
entries.about: True if equal (words ignore case). Same as a = b. Alias: EQUAL?

entries.name: notequalp
entries.about: True if not equal. Same as a <> b. Alias: NOTEQUAL?

entries.name: beforep
entries.about: True if word a sorts before b. Alias: BEFORE?

entries.name: uppercase
entries.about: Convert to upper case.

entries.name: lowercase
entries.about: Convert to lower case.

entries.name: char
entries.about: The character with that code.

entries.name: ascii
entries.about: The code of a character.

entries.name: array
entries.about: Make an array of empty lists. Items count from 1, or from origin. Written {a b c}, or {a b c}@0 for origin 0.

entries.name: mdarray
entries.about: Make an array of arrays, for example mdarray [3 4].

entries.name: listtoarray
entries.about: Make an array holding the list's members.

entries.name: arraytolist
entries.about: The array's members as a list.

entries.name: arrayp
entries.about: True if the thing is an array. Alias: ARRAY?.

entries.name: setitem
entries.about: Change member n of the array. All variables holding that array see the change.

entries.name: mditem
entries.about: Member of a multi-dimensional array.

entries.name: mdsetitem
entries.about: Change a member of a multi-dimensional array.

entries.name: pprop
entries.about: Set a property on a property list.

entries.name: gprop
entries.about: Output the property's value, or [] if it has none.

entries.name: remprop
entries.about: Remove a property.

entries.name: plist
entries.about: Output the property list as [prop value prop value].

entries.name: plists
entries.about: Output the names of all property lists.

entries.name: pps
entries.about: Print every property list as PPROP commands.

entries.name: erps
entries.about: Erase every property list.

entries.name: and
entries.about: True if all inputs are true. Inputs may be [lists] to run. (and a b c) takes more.

entries.name: or
entries.about: True if any input is true.

entries.name: not
entries.about: Reverse true and false.

entries.name: sum
entries.about: Add. (sum a b c) takes more. Same as a + b.

entries.name: difference
entries.about: a - b.

entries.name: product
entries.about: Multiply. (product a b c) takes more. Same as a * b.

entries.name: quotient
entries.about: a / b. With one input, 1 / a.

entries.name: remainder
entries.about: Remainder with the sign of a.

entries.name: modulo
entries.about: Remainder with the sign of b.

entries.name: intquotient
entries.about: Whole-number division.

entries.name: minus
entries.about: Negate.

entries.name: abs
entries.about: Absolute value.

entries.name: int
entries.about: Drop the fraction.

entries.name: round
entries.about: Nearest whole number.

entries.name: sqrt
entries.about: Square root.

entries.name: power
entries.about: a to the power b. Same as a ^ b.

entries.name: exp
entries.about: e to the power a.

entries.name: ln
entries.about: Natural logarithm.

entries.name: log10
entries.about: Base-10 logarithm.

entries.name: sin
entries.about: Sine of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: cos
entries.about: Cosine of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: tan
entries.about: Tangent of an angle in degrees.

entries.name: arctan
entries.about: Arc tangent in degrees. (arctan x y) gives the angle of the point.

entries.name: arcsin
entries.about: Arc sine in degrees.

entries.name: arccos
entries.about: Arc cosine in degrees.

entries.name: random
entries.about: A random whole number from 0 to n-1 in UCBLogo mode, or 1 to n in Terrapin mode. (random a b) gives a..b in either mode.

entries.name: rerandom
entries.about: Reseed the random numbers. (rerandom seed) makes runs repeatable.

entries.name: lessp
entries.about: a < b. Alias: LESS?

entries.name: greaterp
entries.about: a > b. Alias: GREATER?

entries.name: lessequalp
entries.about: a <= b. Alias: LESSEQUAL?

entries.name: greaterequalp
entries.about: a >= b. Alias: GREATEREQUAL?

entries.name: bitand
entries.about: Bitwise and.

entries.name: bitor
entries.about: Bitwise or.

entries.name: bitxor
entries.about: Bitwise exclusive or.

entries.name: ashift
entries.about: Shift left by n bits (right if n is negative).

entries.name: forward
entries.about: Move n steps in the direction the turtle faces. Alias: FD.

entries.name: back
entries.about: Move n steps backwards. Aliases: BK, BACKWARD.

entries.name: left
entries.about: Turn anticlockwise. Alias: LT.

entries.name: right
entries.about: Turn clockwise. Alias: RT.

entries.name: home
entries.about: Go to [0 0] facing up.

entries.name: setpos
entries.about: Move to a position.

entries.name: setxy
entries.about: Move to a position.

entries.name: setx
entries.about: Move horizontally to x.

entries.name: sety
entries.about: Move vertically to y.

entries.name: setheading
entries.about: Face a compass heading (0 is up, 90 is right). Alias: SETH.

entries.name: arc
entries.about: Draw an arc centred on the turtle, clockwise from its heading.

entries.name: dot
entries.about: Plot one dot at a position.

entries.name: pos
entries.about: The position as [x y].

entries.name: xcor
entries.about: The x coordinate.

entries.name: ycor
entries.about: The y coordinate.

entries.name: heading
entries.about: The heading in degrees.

entries.name: towards
entries.about: The heading that would face that position.

entries.name: distance
entries.about: The distance to a position.

entries.name: scrunch
entries.about: The aspect ratio, always [1 1] here.

entries.name: shownp
entries.about: True if the turtle is visible. Alias: SHOWN?

entries.name: pendownp
entries.about: True if the pen is down. Alias: PENDOWN?

entries.name: penmode
entries.about: PAINT, ERASE or REVERSE.

entries.name: pen
entries.about: The pen state: penup, pendown, penerase or penreverse.

entries.name: pencolor
entries.about: The current pen colour: the original input in UCBLogo mode, or [red green blue alpha] in Terrapin mode. NZ spelling: PENCOLOUR.

entries.name: background
entries.about: The background colour: the original input in UCBLogo mode, or [red green blue alpha] in Terrapin mode. NZ spelling: BACKGROUNDCOLOUR.

entries.name: colors
entries.about: Available colour names. Terrapin mode uses indexed Web colours; UCBLogo mode uses its existing palette. US spelling: COLORS.

entries.name: pensize
entries.about: The pen size as [n n].

entries.name: wrapp
entries.about: True in WRAP mode. Alias: WRAP?

entries.name: penup
entries.about: Lift the pen. Alias: PU.

entries.name: pendown
entries.about: Lower the pen. Alias: PD.

entries.name: penpaint
entries.about: Draw normally with the pen down. Alias: PPT.

entries.name: penerase
entries.about: Pen down, erasing what it crosses. Alias: PE.

entries.name: penreverse
entries.about: Pen down, toggling dots on and off. Alias: PX.

entries.name: setpencolor
entries.about: Set the pen colour. UCBLogo: 0-15, names or RGB 0-100. With --colour-mode terrapin: Web names, 0-138 or RGB 0-255 with optional alpha 0-1. US spelling: SETPENCOLOR.

entries.name: setbackground
entries.about: Set the background without changing existing strokes. Uses the selected colour rules; NZ/US spellings are accepted.

entries.name: setpen
entries.about: Set pen state and colour together. Use full state names: PENUP, PENDOWN, PENERASE or PENREVERSE.

entries.name: setalpha
entries.about: Set the default alpha (0-1) for subsequent pen colours in Terrapin mode. Explicit RGBA inputs override it; background colours use alpha 1 unless supplied.

entries.name: alpha
entries.about: The default alpha for subsequent pen colours (initially 1).

entries.name: setpensize
entries.about: Pen width in pixels. Alias: SETWIDTH.

entries.name: setpalette
entries.about: Redefine a UCBLogo palette colour (RGB 0-100; UCBLogo mode only).

entries.name: palette
entries.about: A UCBLogo palette colour as [r g b] (UCBLogo mode only).

entries.name: hideturtle
entries.about: Hide the turtle marker. Alias: HT.

entries.name: showturtle
entries.about: Show the turtle marker. Alias: ST.

entries.name: clearscreen
entries.about: Clear the drawing and send the turtle home. Alias: CS.

entries.name: clean
entries.about: Clear the drawing but leave the turtle where it is.

entries.name: wrap
entries.about: Turtle wraps round the edges of the canvas.

entries.name: window
entries.about: Turtle may wander off-screen (the default).

entries.name: fence
entries.about: Turtle may not leave the canvas: moving out is an error.

entries.name: fill
entries.about: Flood-fill with the pen colour. In Terrapin mode, the pen must be PENDOWN; (FILL tolerance) accepts 0-1, default 0.5, to cross transparent borders. An area enclosed by pen lines becomes a cut-out in a STENCIL.

entries.name: filled
entries.about: Run the instructions, then fill the polygon through every point the turtle visited (pen up or down), back to where it started, and outline it in the pen colour. Where the path crosses itself, alternate regions are filled. The shape becomes a cut-out in a STENCIL.

entries.name: label
entries.about: Write text at the turtle's position.

entries.name: setspeed
entries.about: Watch it draw: 0 is instant, 1 is slow, 5 is the default, 10 is fast. Each step doubles the speed.

entries.name: speed
entries.about: The current SETSPEED value.

entries.name: setscale
entries.about: Pixels per turtle step (default 1). Extension. 0.5 halves drawings.

entries.name: fitwindow
entries.about: Scale so an n x n window (try 1000) fits the canvas, and keep it fitted on resize. Extension. --fit n does the same.

entries.name: textscreen
entries.about: Accepted and ignored. Also FULLSCREEN, SPLITSCREEN (TS, FS, SS).

entries.name: savepict
entries.about: Export the drawing as .svg, .png, .txt or .stl (a stencil). Alias: SAVEPIC.

entries.name: stencil
entries.about: Export a 3D-printable stencil: a flat plate with your pen strokes cut through it as slots and your filled areas (FILL, FILLED) cut out, as a binary STL. The .stl extension is added if the name lacks it. One step is 1 mm and pen size is the slot width (SETPENSIZE 2 for 2 mm). Islands such as the centre of an O are tied back with bridges. A FILL that is not enclosed by pen lines is left out with a warning. Options: thickness 1.2, margin 8, bridge 1.6, bridges 2, width (force every slot), minwidth 0.8, plate [w h], mirror true, pitch 0.2, mm 1, maxgap 15.

entries.name: help
entries.usage: help  or  help name  or  help "category
entries.about: List all commands, or explain one command or a category (turtle, control, arithmetic...).

entries.name: version
entries.about: Output the version and author of termlogo.

entries.name: to
entries.about: Define a procedure. Optional inputs: [:x default]. Rest input: [:rest].

entries.name: operators
entries.about: Infix operators. Parenthesised reporters work in expressions, for example (repcount + 1) and right (-1) ^ (repcount + 1). Write 3 - 4, not 3 -4 (a minus after a space is a sign).

entries.name: words
entries.about: a b| | Quote a word with ". |a b| holds spaces. ; starts a comment.

entries.name: templates
entries.about: Slots and lambdas used by MAP, FILTER, FOREACH and REDUCE.

entries.name: colours
entries.usage: the Colours menu: UCBLogo or Terrapin
entries.about: UCBLogo uses palette 0-15 and RGB 0-100. Terrapin uses indexed Web colours, RGB 0-255 and optional alpha 0-1; PENCOLOR and BACKGROUND report RGBA lists. COLOURS lists names. Both grey and gray spellings are accepted.
